sup:70710.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (1)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar.
Our order history for this part shows 5.17 EUR (po:4500013023-10) against 5.45 EUR in the latest order (po:4500014455-10).
Your letter of 2026-07-06 (doc:20260706-70710-M1) says your material is covered until March 2027.
We accept the AS-14404 index clause on the material share with a 5% deadband; the attached base price reflects the price risk this removes for you.
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 94,800 kg per year over 24 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

Dear customer,
Many thanks for your e-mail, and great to hear from you; I went through it right away with our team.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.54 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
Here is the background.
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We have verified the order history you referenced and have adjusted our pricing to reflect this data.
Please note that as a matter of company policy, we do not disclose internal cost breakdowns.
We are willing to accept the AS-14404 index clause and a 24-month contract, offering €5.51 per unit with 60 days payment terms.
Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €5.41 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.

Our commercial management has reviewed your request and approved a further price reduction based on your binding volume commitment of 94,800 kg per year. Building on your proposal for 60 days payment terms and a 24-month contract, we can offer a revised price of €5.37 per unit. This package includes the AS-14404 index clause, which we agree provides a stable foundation for our cooperation.

Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH. We have verified your forecast data and appreciate the volume commitment. We are always keen to support your production needs with our extensive inventory and reliable service.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our current offer stands at a price of €5.37 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Building on your proposal for 60 days payment terms and a 24-month contract, we can offer a revised price of €5.34 per unit. This alternative package includes a price of €5.34 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This represents a fair step towards your target while reflecting the verified volume increase.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
